sentences.japanese: 彼女の庭は芸術作品です。
sentences.english: Her garden is a work of art.

sentences.japanese: 君は犬が庭を通り抜けて行くのを見なかったかい。
sentences.english: Didn't you see a dog pass through the yard?

sentences.japanese: 我が家の庭は甘い香りの花で満ちている。
sentences.english: My garden is filled with sweet-smelling blooms.

sentences.japanese: 我が家の前には狭い庭があります。
sentences.english: There is a small garden in front of my house.

sentences.japanese: 我が家に庭があればよいのに。
sentences.english: If only we had a garden!
